facts.projectSummary:
## Inkflow — App Clone Brief (Kindle-inspired)

A native SwiftUI ebook + audiobook reading app, structurally faithful to Amazon Kindle's reading experience, differentiated by (1) a strong reading-stats layer (streaks, goals, reading vs listening minutes), (2) a pro audiobook player with read-along, and (3) a daily notes-email digest. Books come from free sources (Project Gutenberg EPUB, Internet Archive text) OR from the user importing their own PDF/EPUB. No store or DRM.

### Authentication (NEW — account-first)
- The app is gated behind sign-in. `AuthStore` (`@Observable`, GoTrue REST, no SDK) owns the session; tokens persist in the Keychain via `AuthKeychain` and auto-refresh.
- `SignInView`: Sign in with Apple (primary, native id-token exchange), Continue with Google (web OAuth + PKCE via ASWebAuthenticationSession), and expandable email/password (sign in / create account).
- Launch flow: restoring → SignInView (signed out) → onboarding (if not completed) → main tabs.
- You tab shows the signed-in name/email and a sign-out menu. The daily-email screen auto-fills the recipient from the signed-in account.
- Provider readiness is external: Supabase Auth must enable Apple + Google with credentials, list redirect `inkflow://auth-callback`, and (for frictionless email) disable Confirm Email. Apple requires the Sign in with Apple entitlement on the bundle ID.

### Reading sources
1. Search free libraries — Project Gutenberg (full EPUBs) + Internet Archive (plain-text), unified search with filters. Cover artwork URLs saved on download.
2. Import your own — any PDF or EPUB fro

metadata.appStoreDescription:
Inkflow is a calm, premium place to read or listen to any book — and your progress follows you across both.

Start a chapter on the page during your commute, switch to narration while you cook, then come back to reading at night. Inkflow keeps your place in sync, so you never lose your spot whether your eyes or your ears are doing the work.

Build a real reading habit. Inkflow quietly tracks every minute you read and every minute you listen, then turns them into streaks, weekly goals, and all-time totals you can actually feel proud of.

WHY INKFLOW

Read or listen to any book, your way. A clean reader for the page and a focused audiobook player with adjustable speed, multiple voices, a sleep timer, and read-along highlighting.

Progress synced across both. Switch between reading and listening anytime — your place carries over automatically.

See every minute add up. Weekly goals, day streaks, and reading versus listening breakdowns keep you motivated without the noise.

Find your next read. Search real books from Project Gutenberg and the Internet Archive and send them straight to your library, or import your own PDF and EPUB files.

AI study notes. Let Inkflow turn your highlights and notes into concise study summaries, delivered to your inbox each morning.

A daily notes email. Get the highlights you save delivered to your inbox every morning, so the ideas that matter actually stick.

Designed to disappear. A warm, paper-and-ink interface that puts the words first and gets out of your way.

Inkflow is built for people who love books and want a quieter, more thoughtful way to read more of them. No clutter, no noise — just you and the next great chapter.

Download Inkflow and turn every spare minute into reading time.

reviewNotes: The app requires an account to use. You may create a test account using email and password from the sign-in screen — no invite code is needed.

Books can be discovered via the in-app search (Project Gutenberg / Internet Archive) or imported as PDF/EPUB from Files.

intro: Inkflow is a reading and audiobook app that helps you build a lasting reading habit. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use Inkflow, how we use it, and the choices available to you.
By creating an account or using the app, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of Inkflow.

bullets: Account information: your email address and display name, collected when you create an account via email/password, Sign in with Apple, or Continue with Google.
Reading and listening activity: books you open, pages read, minutes spent reading or listening, streaks, and goals you set.
Imported content metadata: titles and file names of PDF or EPUB files you import. File contents are processed locally on your device and are not uploaded to our servers.
Notes and highlights: annotations you save within a book, which may be included in your daily email digest.
Subscription and purchase information: records of active or past subscriptions processed through Apple's App Store.
Usage and diagnostic data: app interactions, feature usage patterns, and crash reports collected to improve app performance.
Email delivery data: the email address you designate for your daily notes digest, used solely to deliver that digest via Resend.
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly, information generated by your use of the app, and technical data necessary to operate the service.
sections.title: Information We Collect

bullets: To authenticate your account and keep your session secure across devices.
To sync your reading position, progress statistics, streaks, and goals.
To generate AI-powered study notes from your reading content using OpenAI.
To send your daily notes email digest to the address you provide.
To process and validate your in-app subscription through Apple's StoreKit.
To analyze aggregate usage patterns so we can improve features and fix bugs.
To respond to support requests you submit.
paragraphs: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
sections.title: How We Use Information

paragraphs: We use Supabase as our backend provider for authentication, database storage, and Edge Functions. Your account credentials and reading data are stored in Supabase's infrastructure. Sessions are secured using tokens stored in your device's Keychain.
We use OpenAI's API to generate AI study notes from content you choose to process. Text submitted for note generation is transmitted to OpenAI subject to OpenAI's privacy and data-use policies.
We use Resend to deliver your daily notes email digest. Your designated email address is shared with Resend solely for the purpose of delivering that digest.

We use analytics tooling to collect anonymized, aggregated usage data. This data helps us understand how features are used and identify areas for improvement. It is not linked to your identity for advertising purposes.
We do not use advertising SDKs or share data for third-party advertising or cross-app tracking.
sections.title: Product And Technical Data

bullets: Service providers: Supabase (infrastructure and authentication), OpenAI (AI note generation), Resend (email delivery), and our analytics provider — each receiving only the data necessary to perform their function.
Apple: subscription and purchase information is processed by Apple's App Store infrastructure.
Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required by law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of our users or the public.
Business transfers: if Inkflow is acquired or merged, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only in the limited circumstances described below.
sections.title: How We Share Information

paragraphs: We retain your account and reading data for as long as your account remains active. If you sign out or stop using the app, your data remains stored until you request deletion.

To request deletion of your account and associated data, please contact us using the information in the Contact section below. We will process your request within a reasonable time frame and confirm when deletion is complete.
sections.title: Data Retention

bullets: Email digest: you can disable the daily notes email at any time within the app's settings.
AI notes: submitting content to OpenAI for note generation is an action you initiate; you can simply not use the feature.
Account data: you may request access to or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.
Analytics: aggregate usage analytics help us maintain and improve the app. Specific opt-out options depend on your device's system settings.
paragraphs: You have the following choices regarding your data:
sections.title: Your Choices

paragraphs: Inkflow is not directed at children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected data from a child under 13 without verified parental consent, we will delete it promptly.
If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.
sections.title: Children's Privacy

paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us. Because certain contact details were not provided at the time this policy was generated, please refer to the support page within the Inkflow app for current contact information.
We will respond to privacy inquiries within a reasonable time frame.

intro: We want your Inkflow experience to be smooth and enjoyable. If you run into a problem or have a question, this page explains how to get help and what to expect.

paragraphs: To contact the Inkflow support team, please use the support link available within the app's settings, or reach out through the contact information listed on the app's App Store page.

Please note that a dedicated support email address was not specified at the time this page was generated. Check the app's current settings screen or App Store listing for the most up-to-date contact details.
sections.title: How To Reach Support

bullets: Your device model and iOS version (e.g., iPhone 15, iOS 17.4).
The Inkflow app version (found in the App Store under your purchases, or in Settings > About).
A clear description of what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
Steps to reproduce the issue if it occurs consistently.
Any relevant screenshots or screen recordings, if possible.
paragraphs: To help us resolve your issue as quickly as possible, please include the following in your message:
sections.title: What To Include In Your Request

bullets: Sign in with Apple: ensure that your Apple ID has not revoked Inkflow's permissions. Check Settings > Apple ID > Password & Security > Apps Using Apple ID.
Sign in with Google: if the OAuth flow fails, try again with a stable internet connection. Make sure you complete the in-app browser prompt without closing it early.
Email and password: double-check your credentials. Use the password reset option if you have forgotten your password.
If your account appears to have data missing, ensure you are signed in with the same provider and email you used originally.
For persistent access issues, contact support with the details listed in the section above.
paragraphs: If you are unable to sign in or access your account, here are some steps to try first:
sections.title: Account And Access Issues

bullets: To manage, pause, or cancel your subscription: go to Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your iPhone.
To request a refund: visit reportaproblem.apple.com and follow Apple's refund process.
If you believe a subscription was charged in error, or if a purchase is not reflected in the app, contact us with your Apple Order ID and we will investigate.
paragraphs: Inkflow subscriptions are managed entirely through Apple's App Store. We do not process payments directly and cannot issue refunds on Apple's behalf.
sections.title: Billing And Subscription Help

paragraphs: You have the right to request access to or deletion of the personal data we hold about you. To submit a data access or deletion request, contact us via the support channel within the app and include the email address associated with your account.

We will acknowledge your request promptly and process it within a reasonable time frame. Note that certain data may be retained for the minimum period required by law or for legitimate operational purposes.
sections.title: Privacy And Data Requests

paragraphs: We aim to respond to all support requests within 2–3 business days. Complex issues, such as account recovery or data requests, may take a little longer. We appreciate your patience and will keep you updated on the status of your request.
sections.title: Response Expectations
